loop: Call PositionsTotal once. If signed low32 total is negative, keep last_ticket and return after local-string cleanup. Otherwise cache seed from signed32 magic_base, compute accepted identities before looping, and visit total,total-1,...,0 inclusive.
identities: For offsets 1..identity_count, add modulo2^32 then sign-extend to64. Repeatedly call PositionGetInteger(12) in offset order, short-circuit on the first full64 match. Zero tickets skip all property reads.
symbol: Assign PositionGetString(0) to one persistent local string. Compare exact nullable UTF16 text against the current shared symbol; two null pointers match, only one null does not. No case folding.
accepted: Read PositionGetInteger(2) full64; accept0 in first function or1 in second. Read and discard PositionGetDouble(3), then read current global last_ticket and call the full existing close guard (including reselect/filling/send/messages). Continue scanning afterwards.
read_timing: Last ticket is assigned after every PositionGetTicket. Cached identity list survives later seed changes. Symbol is re-read for each comparison. The helper argument is loaded after the ignored volume query; callbacks may change last_ticket before it is read.
remaining: Compile/compare all four selectors including the complete close path and observable state at query boundaries.
Shared-reference/threshold producer ordering,actual account selection,full EA and allocation faults remain open.
